hero.subtitle: GLOBAL GLACIER MONITORING
hero.title: GLACIO WATCH
hero.description: ADVANCED SATELLITE ANALYSIS OF HIMALAYAN GLACIER RETREAT
hero.behindDescription: More than a study, GlacioWatch is a real-time dialogue with the changing Earth, mapping the silent transformations of our planet's frozen giants.

artist.title: MONITORING SYSTEM
artist.p1: GlacioWatch utilizes state-of-the-art Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and advanced machine learning algorithms to monitor the retreat of 29 major Himalayan glaciers across 5 Indian states.
artist.p2: Our system provides daily updates on surface area changes, thermal anomalies, and mass balance, transforming raw spectral data into actionable insights for climate scientists and policy makers.

about.subtitle: ABOUT THE MISSION
about.title: THE STORY BEHIND THE MONITORING
about.description: A mission of precision, environmental stewardship, and an unwavering dedication to documenting the vanishing ice of the Third Pole.
about.quote: The glaciers are the Earth's most sensitive thermometers. They tell a story of change that we can no longer afford to ignore.

milestones.title: Initial Scoping
milestones.description: Identification of critical glacial zones in the Karakoram and Zanskar ranges requiring high-frequency monitoring.

milestones.title: Satellite Integration
milestones.description: Seamless integration with ESA's Sentinel-2 constellation, enabling automated daily data acquisition and processing.

milestones.title: AI Model Deployment
milestones.description: Deployment of proprietary change-detection algorithms capable of identifying sub-meter shifts in glacial boundaries.

milestones.title: Global Archive
milestones.description: Maintaining a comprehensive historical record of glacial health, providing the data needed to predict future water security.

values.title: PRECISION
values.description: Every measurement is validated against multiple spectral bands to ensure scientific accuracy.

values.title: TRANSPARENCY
values.description: Our data and methodologies are open to the scientific community for peer review and collaborative research.

values.title: VIGILANCE
values.description: 24/7 automated monitoring ensures no significant glacial event goes unrecorded.

values.title: PURPOSE
values.description: Providing the critical evidence needed to drive global climate action and regional water management.

footer.description: A comprehensive monitoring platform dedicated to the preservation and study of the world's most critical glacial ecosystems.
